name: TC-366: creating a chain deal in the chain shell goes through the fan-out confirm and lands at every location
description: Chain shell → Create Deal: the picker lists shared master items (anchor-location caption), the submit reads 'Create deal for all 2 locations', clicking it opens 'Heads up — chain-wide change' → Continue → POST /api/chains/:gid/deals 201 → 'Deal created successfully' → back on the chain table with a 'Chain' row; public /active at BOTH locations lists it. (The fan-out confirm is suppressed for the rest of the browser session after the first Continue — this test clears that flag first.)
